# Borderlands Quest: Goblin Trouble

*A short adventure for four to six level 1 characters*

*Borderlands Quest: Goblin Trouble* is a Dungeons & Dragons adventure that introduces four to six new players to the game and teaches you, the Dungeon Master, how to run it for them. This short adventure is meant to last approximately 1-2 hours of play.
